clue.text: Fall asleep in ditch by side of road?

parts.note: to ditch something is to drop it or let it go
the off side is the side of the road away from the kerb, the driver's side in Britain

explanation.surface: A sleepy driver nods off and ends up in a roadside ditch.
explanation.definitionFit: To nod off into sleep is a familiar idiom with exactly this sense, said of someone dozing.

clue.text: Special shrine stores the ultimate in church wine

indicators.note: stores means keeps inside, so one piece is held within the other
special here suggests something specially reworked, so the letters of shrine are rearranged
the ultimate in a word is its last letter

explanation.surface: A particular shrine keeps a supply of church wine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Special' turns SHRINE into RENISH, and 'stores' puts H, the last letter of 'church', inside it after the R.
explanation.definitionFit: Hock and other Rhine-valley vintages are called by this name, so it is a type of wine.

clue.text: Manger apt to be shown transformed by star

indicators.note: transformed means changed in form, so the letters of the two words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A Nativity manger is given a new look by the star of Bethlehem.
explanation.walkthrough: 'transformed' rearranges the nine letters of MANGER APT.
explanation.definitionFit: A five-pointed figure drawn with a continuous line is a star shape, the occultist's emblem.

clue.text: It's better to lock up daughter, one discovers

indicators.note: to lock up is to shut someone inside, so one piece encloses the other

parts.note: better in quality means finer
D is the standard abbreviation for daughter in family trees

explanation.surface: A protective parent thinks it wiser to keep a daughter locked away.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who discovers or locates a thing is literally its locator, the person who comes upon it.

clue.text: Encourage paranormal communication sitting by river

parts.note: ESP, extrasensory perception, is supposed communication by telepathy
the Ouse is a river in Yorkshire and another in East Anglia

explanation.surface: A medium by the riverbank urges on séances and mind-reading.
explanation.definitionFit: To take up and support a cause is to champion or promote it, so the verb shares the sense of backing.

clue.text: After end of tedious debate, hurry for a drink

indicators.note: after tells us the next piece follows the first one
the end of a word is its last letter

parts.note: to moot is to raise for debate; a moot is a debate
hie is an old word meaning hurry

explanation.surface: Once a dull argument is over, rush off for something to drink.
explanation.walkthrough: 'After' signals that the debate word follows the last letter of 'tedious'; 'hie' is an archaic verb for hasten.
explanation.definitionFit: A thick blended beverage of fruit, yoghurt or milk is a popular modern drink.

clue.text: Offensive while filming

definitions.meaning: an offensive is an attack, the start of an assault
actors on a film set are at work while the cameras roll

explanation.surface: Something rude was said during the shoot.
explanation.definitionFit: The noun means an assault or attack; split in two it describes being at the film studio during shooting.

clue.text: Dog Rex finally escaping from snare

indicators.note: the final letter gets away, so the closing letter is removed

parts.note: a springer is a spaniel breed
R is the abbreviation of Rex, Latin for king

explanation.surface: Rex the dog finally wriggles out of a trap.
explanation.walkthrough: Remove the last letter, R, from SPRINGER, the spaniel; Shakespeare's Polonius speaks of 'springes to catch woodcocks'.
explanation.definitionFit: An old word for a noose-trap used to catch small birds and game, so a type of snare.

clue.text: Performing masculine arts, do oneself an injury

indicators.note: performing means putting through a routine, so these letters are worked into a new order

explanation.surface: Doing macho martial arts, a man hurts himself.
explanation.definitionFit: Pulling or overstretching a muscle is a common physical injury a person can inflict on themself.

clue.text: Singer wanting peace — one of his names is a "bully"

indicators.note: is here works as becomes, so one letter is swapped for another

parts.note: John Lennon sang Give Peace a Chance and campaigned for peace
N is the abbreviation for name, and the singer's surname has more than one N

explanation.surface: A peace-loving singer has a name that means 'bully'.
explanation.walkthrough: One of the Ns (N = name) in LENNON is replaced by A, which 'is' signals.
explanation.definitionFit: To pressure or intimidate someone into doing something is a phrasal-verb sense of bullying.

clue.text: See 15
Three at front of school bedroom finding beetle

indicators.note: only the first three letters are kept, the rest dropped

parts.note: a dormitory is the shared bedroom at a boarding school

explanation.surface: Three pupils at the front of a boarding-school dorm find a beetle.
explanation.definitionFit: A dung beetle of Europe, also called a dumbledor, is known by this short old name.

clue.text: After examination, church is found to be lively

indicators.note: after places the church abbreviation following the first piece

parts.note: a viva is an oral university examination
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: After an inspection, a church is pronounced to be thriving.
explanation.definitionFit: A musical direction meaning brisk and spirited, so it is a tempo marking for lively playing.

clue.text: At home in a country that is highly unstable

definitions.note: the definition describes a thing, a noun, that is unstable

indicators.note: in places one piece inside the other

parts.note: a state is a country
at home means in, as in 'is anyone in?'

explanation.surface: Staying in a country that is in political turmoil.
explanation.walkthrough: IN goes inside A STATE, before its final E. 'At' is also this element's chemical symbol.
explanation.definitionFit: This radioactive halogen element decays within hours, the rarest naturally occurring element and highly unstable.

clue.text: Bottom gear for some kids on bikes?

definitions.text: Bottom gear for some kids on bikes?

parts.words: Bottom gear for some kids on bikes?
parts.note: gear covering the bottom is clothing, and young boys wear knee-length legwear; 'bottom gear' also suggests a bicycle's lowest gear

explanation.surface: Cyclists' lowest gear, suited to children riding bikes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bottom gear' looks like a bike gear, but it is clothing for the bottom; boys traditionally wore knee-length legwear.
explanation.definitionFit: Knee-length legwear worn by schoolboys is clothing for the bottom, hence bottom gear for kids.

clue.text: Imagined very wise person embracing one in death

indicators.note: in puts the whole assembly inside the other word

parts.note: the end is death

indicators.note: embracing means holding within, so one letter goes inside

parts.note: a sage is a wise person
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Pictured a very wise man holding someone as they died.
explanation.walkthrough: Two containers: 'embracing' puts the one inside the very wise person, and 'in' puts the result inside death.
explanation.definitionFit: To picture something in the mind as a possibility is to foresee it, a synonym of imagined.

clue.text: Not everything intended to be heard in residence

parts.note: a part is not everything, only some of it

indicators.note: to be heard means spoken, so a word that sounds the same is used

parts.note: intended means meant

explanation.surface: Not everything meant to be overheard in the house.
explanation.definitionFit: A flat or set of rooms where someone lives is a dwelling, a residence.

clue.text: Insect to suffer as the result of being constricted

indicators.note: suffer here means be battered about, so the letters are knocked into a new order

explanation.surface: An insect suffers because it has been squeezed tight.
explanation.definitionFit: A medical adjective for a vessel or valve that has narrowed abnormally, so it means constricted.

clue.text: Inform the enemy when most are watching

parts.note: to prime someone is to brief or inform them in advance
time is the enemy, as in the saying 'time is the enemy'

explanation.surface: A spy tips off the foe at the moment everyone is looking.
explanation.definitionFit: The evening TV slot with the largest audience is the peak viewing period, so when most viewers tune in.

clue.text: Boy entertained by womaniser's musical embellishment

indicators.note: entertained means taken in as a guest, so the boy goes inside

parts.note: a roué is a rake or womaniser; the 's is no letter
a lad is a boy

explanation.surface: A youth is hosted by a lothario with a flourish of music.
explanation.definitionFit: A run of quick notes sung on one syllable is a vocal flourish, an ornament in music.

clue.text: Hazel has these essayist's stories read out

indicators.note: read out means spoken, so the words are taken by their sound

parts.note: Charles Lamb, the essayist, wrote Tales from Shakespeare with his sister Mary

explanation.surface: A girl called Hazel owns the essayist's stories, recited aloud.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hazel' looks like a woman's name, but it is the tree, whose dangling catkins carry this name.
explanation.definitionFit: The hanging catkins of the hazel tree are popularly named after a young sheep's dangling tails.

clue.text: Matador's fruit?

parts.note: a champion bullfighter could be called an ace with bulls, and the word split that way names a small wild plum

explanation.surface: A bullfighter's favourite fruit.
explanation.walkthrough: Split as BULL ACE, the answer suggests an expert matador.
explanation.definitionFit: A small wild plum, related to the damson, grows on hedgerow trees and is a fruit.

clue.text: Report of Cockney's tougher passion

indicators.note: a report is a sound, so the answer is the word that is heard

parts.note: a Cockney drops the initial H, so harder comes out as 'arder

explanation.surface: An account of a tougher Londoner's strong feelings.
explanation.walkthrough: Cockneys, working-class Londoners, drop their H sounds.
explanation.definitionFit: Great enthusiasm or intense feeling is fervour, a synonym of passion.

clue.text: Religious reformer holds smart political meeting

indicators.note: holds means contains, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: Jan Hus was a Czech church reformer burnt in 1415
to smart is to sting

explanation.surface: A church reformer convenes a smart gathering on politics.
explanation.definitionFit: Election campaigning and the public gatherings where candidates address voters are called by this name.

clue.text: See 21
Irritate man with the baton

definitions.meaning: Sir Simon ..., the conductor, wields a baton

explanation.surface: Annoy the conductor holding the stick.
explanation.definitionFit: To unsettle someone is to fluster them; Sir Simon of that name is a famous British orchestra conductor.

clue.text: Rubbish food with chips?

definitions.meaning: British slang for fake or sham, hence worthless
a white fish served battered in a British chippy

explanation.surface: Rubbish food that comes with chips.
explanation.definitionFit: Slang for sham or bogus, and the white fish traditionally paired with chips in British fish suppers.

clue.text: Some wine is very, very dry — inadequate alongside the others

indicators.note: inadequate means falling short, so the last letter is dropped

parts.note: arid means very dry
et al, from Latin et alii, means and the others

explanation.surface: A wine that is bone dry falls short beside the rest.
explanation.walkthrough: 'inadequate' cuts the last letter from ARID; 'alongside' joins ET AL.
explanation.definitionFit: A wine made mainly from one grape and labelled with its name is a kind of wine, so some wine.

clue.text: With no one else to help, call number back

definitions.text: With no one else to help

indicators.note: back means read the other way, so the whole run is reversed

parts.note: to call is to name

explanation.surface: Working solo, ring a number back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' reverses NAME NO as one run.
explanation.definitionFit: Describes a show or business run by a single person, done solo, so without anyone else helping.

clue.text: Stylish Italian account given in poetry

indicators.note: given in means placed inside, so one piece goes into the other

parts.note: verse is poetry

explanation.surface: An elegant Italian's story is told in verse.
explanation.definitionFit: Gianni of that name was an Italian fashion designer whose house is famed for stylish clothes.

clue.text: Pottage offered with little hesitation — by one to another?

parts.note: pottage is a thick soup, a broth
er is the sound of a short hesitation

explanation.surface: Soup is served with a pause, passed from one person to another.
explanation.walkthrough: Jacob sold Esau pottage for his birthright; Esau and Jacob were siblings.
explanation.definitionFit: Siblings or monks are each this to one another, as in a male sibling or member of an order.
